text: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "If any man wishes to walk in my steps, let him renounce self, and take up his cross, and follow me.

title: Matthew 16:25
text: For whoever wishes to save his life will lose it, and whoever, for my sake, loses his life shall find it.

title: Matthew 16:26
text: What good will it do a man to gain the whole world, if he forfeits his life? or what will a man give that is of equal value with his life?

title: Matthew 16:27
text: For the Son of Man is to come in his Father's Glory, with his angels, and then he 'will give to every man what his actions deserve.'

title: Matthew 16:28
text: I tell you, some of those who are standing here will not know death till they have seen the Son of Man coming into his Kingdom."

title: Matthew 17:1
text: Six days later, Jesus took with him Peter, and the brothers James and John, and led them up a high mountain alone.

title: Matthew 17:2
text: There his appearance was transformed before their eyes; his face shown like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

title: Matthew 17:3
text: And all at once Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Jesus.

title: Matthew 17:4
text: "Master," exclaimed Peter, interposing, "it is good to be here; if you wish, I will make three tents here, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

title: Matthew 17:5
text: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and there was a voice from the cloud that said-- "This is my Son, the Beloved, in whom I delight; him you must hear."

title: Matthew 17:6
text: The disciples, on hearing this, fell on their faces, greatly afraid.

title: Matthew 17:7
text: But Jesus came and touched them, saying as he did so: "Rise up, and do not be afraid."

title: Matthew 17:8
text: When they raised their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus himself alone.

title: Matthew 17:9
text: As they were going down the mountain side, Jesus gave them this warning--"Do not speak of this vision to any one, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."

title: Matthew 17:10
text: "How is it," his disciples asked, "that our Teachers of the Law say that Elijah has to come first?"

title: Matthew 17:11
text: "Elijah indeed does come," Jesus replied, "and will restore everything;

title: Matthew 17:12
text: And I tell you that Elijah has already come, and people have not recognized him, but have treated him just as they pleased. In the same way, too, the Son of Man is destined to undergo suffering at men's hands."

title: Matthew 17:13
text: Then the disciples understood that it was of John the Baptist that he had spoken to them.

title: Matthew 17:14
text: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus, and, kneeling down before him, said:

title: Matthew 17:15
text: "Master, take pity on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers terribly; indeed, he often falls into the fire and into the water;

title: Matthew 17:16
text: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not cure him."

title: Matthew 17:17
text: "O faithless and perverse generation!" Jesus exclaimed, "how long must I be among you? how long must I have patience with you? Bring the boy here to me."

title: Matthew 17:18
text: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy; and he was cured from that very hour.

title: Matthew 17:19
text: Afterwards the disciples came up to Jesus, and asked him privately: "Why was it that we could not drive it out?"

title: Matthew 17:20
text: "Because you have so little faith," he answered; "for, I tell you, if your faith were only like a mustard-seed, you could say to this mountain 'Move from this place to that!' and it would be moved; and nothing would be impossible to you."

title: Matthew 17:21
text: (Translation omits this verse.)

title: Matthew 17:22
text: While Jesus and his disciples were together in Galilee, he said to them: "The Son of Man is destined to be betrayed into the hands of his fellow-men,

title: Matthew 17:23
text: And they will put him to death, but on the third day he will rise." And the disciples were greatly distressed.

title: Matthew 17:24
text: After they had reached Capernaum, the collectors of the Temple-rate came up to Peter, and said: "Does not your Master pay the Temple-rate?"

title: Matthew 17:25
text: "Yes," answered Peter. But, on going into the house, before he could speak, Jesus said: "What do you think, Simon? From whom do earthly kings take taxes or tribute? From their sons, or from others?"

title: Matthew 17:26
text: "From others," answered Peter. "Well then," continued Jesus, "their sons go free.

title: Matthew 17:27
text: Still, that we may not shock them, go and throw a line into the Sea; take the first fish that rises, open its mouth, and you will find in it a piece of money. Take that, and give it to the collectors for both of us."

title: Matthew 18:1
text: On the same occasion the disciples came to Jesus, and asked him: "Who is really the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?"

title: Matthew 18:2
text: Jesus called a little child to him, and placed it in the middle of them, and then said:

title: Matthew 18:3
text: "I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will not enter the Kingdom of Heaven at all.

title: Matthew 18:4
text: Therefore, any one who will humble himself like this child-- that man shall be the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

title: Matthew 18:5
text: And any one who, for the sake of my Name, welcomes even one little child like this, is welcoming me.

title: Matthew 18:6
text: But, if any one puts a snare in the way of one of these lowly ones who believe in me, it would be best for him to be sunk in the depths of the sea with a great millstone hung round his neck.

title: Matthew 18:7
text: Alas for the world because of such snares! There cannot but be snares; yet alas for the man who is answerable for the snare!

title: Matthew 18:8
text: If your hand or your foot is a snare to you, cut it off, and throw it away. It would be better for you to enter the Life maimed or lame, than to have both hands, or both feet, and be thrown into the aeonian fire.

title: Matthew 18:9
text: If your eye is a snare to you, take it out, and throw it away. It would be better for you to enter the Life with only one eye, than to have both eyes and be thrown into the fiery Pit.

title: Matthew 18:10
text: Beware of despising one of these lowly ones, for in Heaven, I tell you, their angels always see the face of my Father who is in Heaven.

title: Matthew 18:11
text: **(Translation omits this verse)

title: Matthew 18:12
text: What think you? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them strays, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills, and go and search for the one that is straying?

title: Matthew 18:13
text: And, if he succeeds in finding it, I tell you that he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine which did not stray.

title: Matthew 18:14
text: So, too, it is the will of my Father who is in Heaven that not one of these lowly ones should be lost.

title: Matthew 18:15
text: If your Brother does wrong, go to him and convince him of his fault when you and he are alone. If he listens to you, you have won your Brother.

title: Matthew 18:16
text: But, if he does not listen to you, take with you one or two others, so that 'on the evidence of two or three witnesses, every word may be put beyond dispute.'

title: Matthew 18:17
text: If he refuses to listen to them, speak to the Church; and, if he also refuses to listen to the Church, treat him as you would a Gentile or a tax-gatherer.

title: Matthew 18:18
text: I tell you, all that you forbid on earth will be held in Heaven to be forbidden, and all that you allow on earth will be held in Heaven to be allowed.

title: Matthew 18:19
text: Again, I tell you that, if but two of you on earth agree as to what they shall pray for, whatever it be, it will be granted them by my Father who is in Heaven.

title: Matthew 18:20
text: For where two or three have come together in my Name, I am present with them."

title: Matthew 18:21
text: Then Peter came up, and said to Jesus: "Master, how often am I to forgive my Brother when he wrongs me? As many as seven times?"

title: Matthew 18:22
text: But Jesus answered: "Not seven times, but 'seventy times seven.'

title: Matthew 18:23
text: And therefore the Kingdom of Heaven may be compared to a king who wished to settle accounts with his servants.

title: Matthew 18:24
text: When he had begun to do so, one of them was brought to him who owed him six million pounds;

title: Matthew 18:25
text: And, as he could not pay, his master ordered him to be sold towards the payment of the debt, together with his wife, and his children, and everything that he had.

title: Matthew 18:26
text: Thereupon the servant threw himself down on the ground before him and said 'Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.'

title: Matthew 18:27
text: The master was moved with compassion; and he let him go, and forgave him the debt.

title: Matthew 18:28
text: But, on going out, that same servant came upon one of his fellow-servants who owed him ten pounds. Seizing him by the throat, he said 'Pay what you owe me.'

title: Matthew 18:29
text: Thereupon his fellow-servant threw himself on the ground and begged for mercy. 'Have patience with me,' he said, 'and I will pay you.'

title: Matthew 18:30
text: But the other would not, but went and put him in prison till he should pay his debt.

title: Matthew 18:31
text: When his fellow-servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and went to their master and laid the whole matter before him.

title: Matthew 18:32
text: Upon that the master sent for the servant, and said to him 'You wicked servant! When you begged me for mercy, I forgave you the whole of that debt.

title: Matthew 18:33
text: Ought not you, also, to have shown mercy to your fellow- servant, just as I showed mercy to you?'

title: Matthew 18:34
text: Then his master, in anger, handed him over to the jailers, until he should pay the whole of his debt.

title: Matthew 18:35
text: So, also, will my heavenly Father do to you, unless each one of you forgives his Brother from his heart."

title: Matthew 19:1
text: At the conclusion of this teaching, Jesus withdrew from Galilee, and went into that district of Judea which is on the other side of the Jordan.

title: Matthew 19:2
text: Great crowds followed him, and he cured them there.

title: Matthew 19:3
text: Presently some Pharisees came up to him, and, to test him, said: "Has a man the right to divorce his wife for every cause?"

title: Matthew 19:4
text: "Have not you read," replied Jesus, "that at the beginning the Creator 'made them male and female,'

title: Matthew 19:5
text: And said--'For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother, and be united to his wife, and the man and his wife shall become one'?

title: Matthew 19:6
text: So that they are no longer two, but one. What God himself, then, has yoked together man must not separate."

title: Matthew 19:7
text: "Why, then," they said, "did Moses direct that a man should 'serve his wife with a notice of separation and divorce her'?"

title: Matthew 19:8
text: "Moses, owing to the hardness of your hearts," answered Jesus, "permitted you to divorce your wives, but that was not so at the beginning.

title: Matthew 19:9
text: But I tell you that any one who divorces his wife, except on the ground of her unchastity, and marries another woman, is guilty of adultery."

title: Matthew 19:10
text: "If that," said the disciples, "is the position of a man with regard to his wife, it is better not to marry."

title: Matthew 19:11
text: "It is not every one," replied Jesus, "who can accept this teaching, but only those who have been enabled to do so.

title: Matthew 19:12
text: Some men, it is true, have from birth been disabled for marriage, while others have been disabled by their fellow men, and others again have disabled themselves for the sake of the Kingdom of Heaven. Let him accept it who can."

title: Matthew 19:13
text: Then some little children were brought to Jesus, for him to place his hands on them, and pray; but the disciples found fault with those who had brought them.

title: Matthew 19:14
text: Jesus, however, said: "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for it is to the childlike that the Kingdom of Heaven belongs."

title: Matthew 19:15
text: So he placed his hands on them, and then went on his way.

title: Matthew 19:16
text: And a man came up to Jesus, and said: "Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain Immortal life?"

title: Matthew 19:17
text: "Why ask me about goodness?" answered Jesus. "There is but One who is good. If you want to enter the Life, keep the commandments."

title: Matthew 19:18
text: "What commandments?" asked the man. "These," answered Jesus:- -"'Thou shalt not kill. Thou shalt not commit adultery. Thou shalt not steal. Thou shalt not say what is false about others.

title: Matthew 19:19
text: Honor thy father and thy mother.' And 'Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thou dost thyself."

title: Matthew 19:20
text: "I have observed all these," said the young man. "What is still wanting in me?"

title: Matthew 19:21
text: "If you wish to be perfect," answered Jesus, "go and sell your property, and give to the poor, and you shall have wealth in Heaven; then come and follow me."

title: Matthew 19:22
text: On hearing these words, the young man went away distressed, for he had great possessions.

title: Matthew 19:23
text: At this, Jesus said to his disciples: "I tell you that a rich man will find it hard to enter the Kingdom of Heaven!

title: Matthew 19:24
text: I say again, it is easier for a camel to get through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of Heaven!"

title: Matthew 19:25
text: On hearing this, the disciples exclaimed in great astonishment: "Who then can possibly be saved?"

title: Matthew 19:26
text: But Jesus looked at them, and said: "With men this is impossible, but with God everything is possible." Then Peter turned and said to Jesus:

title: Matthew 19:27
text: "But we--we left everything, and followed you; what, then, shall we have?"

title: Matthew 19:28
text: "I tell you," answered Jesus, "that at the New Creation, 'when the Son of Man takes his seat on his throne of glory,' you who followed me shall be seated upon twelve thrones, as judges of the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Matthew 19:29
text: Every one who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or land, on account of my Name, will receive many times as much, and will 'gain Immortal Life.'

title: Matthew 19:30
text: But many who are first now will then be last, and those who are last will be first.

title: Matthew 20:1
text: For the Kingdom of Heaven is like an employer who went out in the early morning to hire laborers for his vineyards.

title: Matthew 20:2
text: He agreed with the laborers to pay them two shillings a day, and sent them into his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:3
text: On going out again, about nine o'clock, he saw some others standing in the market-place, doing nothing.

title: Matthew 20:4
text: 'You also may go into my vineyard,' he said, 'and I will pay you what is fair.'

title: Matthew 20:5
text: So the men went. Going out again about mid-day and about three o'clock, he did as before.

title: Matthew 20:6
text: When he went out about five, he found some other men standing there, and said to them 'Why have you been standing here all day long, doing nothing?'

title: Matthew 20:7
text: 'Because no one has hired us,' they answered. 'You also may go into my vineyard,' he said.

title: Matthew 20:8
text: In the evening the owner of the vineyard said to his steward 'Call the laborers, and pay them their wages, beginning with the last, and ending with the first.

title: Matthew 20:9
text: Now when those who had been hired about five o'clock went up, they received two shillings each.

title: Matthew 20:10
text: So, when the first went up, they thought that they would receive more, but they also received two shillings each;

title: Matthew 20:11
text: On which they began to grumble at their employer.

title: Matthew 20:12
text: 'These last,' they said, 'have done only one hour's work, and yet you have put them on the same footing with us, who have borne the brunt of the day's work, and the heat.'

title: Matthew 20:13
text: 'My friend,' was his reply to one of them, 'I am not treating you unfairly. Did not you agree with me for two shillings?

title: Matthew 20:14
text: Take what belongs to you, and go. I choose to give to this last man the same as to you.

title: Matthew 20:15
text: Have not I the right to do as I choose with what is mine? Are you envious because I am liberal?'

title: Matthew 20:16
text: So those who are last will be first, and the first last."

title: Matthew 20:17
text: When Jesus was on the point of going up to Jerusalem, he gathered the twelve disciples round him by themselves, and said to them as they were on their way:

title: Matthew 20:18
text: "Listen! We are going up to Jerusalem; and there the Son of Man will be betrayed to the Chief Priests and Teachers of the Law, and they will condemn him to death,

title: Matthew 20:19
text: And give him up to the Gentiles for them to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify; and on the third day he will rise."

title: Matthew 20:20
text: Then the mother of Zebediah's sons came to him with her sons, bowing to the ground, and begging a favor.

title: Matthew 20:21
text: "What is it that you want?" he asked. "I want you to say," she replied, "that in your Kingdom these two sons of mine may sit, one on your right, and the other on your left."

title: Matthew 20:22
text: "You do not know what you are asking," was Jesus' answer. "Can you drink the cup that I am to drink?" "Yes," they exclaimed, "we can."

title: Matthew 20:23
text: "You shall indeed drink my cup," he said, "but as to a seat at my right and at my left--that is not mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by my Father."

title: Matthew 20:24
text: On hearing of this, the ten others were very indignant about the two brothers.

title: Matthew 20:25
text: Jesus, however, called the ten to him, and said: "The rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them as you know, and their great men oppress them.

title: Matthew 20:26
text: Among you it is not so.

title: Matthew 20:27
text: No, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant, and whoever wants to take the first place among you, must be your slave;

title: Matthew 20:28
text: Just as the Son of Man came, not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

title: Matthew 20:29
text: As they were going out of Jericho, a great crowd followed him.

title: Matthew 20:30
text: Two blind men who were sitting by the road-side, hearing that Jesus was passing, called out: "Take pity on us, Master, Son of David!"

title: Matthew 20:31
text: The crowd told them to be quiet; but the men only called out the louder: "Take pity on us, Master, Son of David!"

title: Matthew 20:32
text: Then Jesus stopped and called them. "What do you want me to do for you?" he said.

title: Matthew 20:33
text: "Master," they replied, "we want our eyes to be opened."

title: Matthew 20:34
text: So Jesus, moved with compassion, touched their eyes, and immediately they recovered their sight, and followed him.

title: Matthew 21:1
text: When they had almost reached Jerusalem, having come as far as Bethphage, on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent on two disciples.

title: Matthew 21:2
text: "Go to the village facing you," he said," and you will immediately find an ass tethered, with a foal by her side; untie her, and lead her here for me.

title: Matthew 21:3
text: And, if any one says anything to you, you are to say this-- 'The Master wants them'; and he will send them at once."

title: Matthew 21:4
text: This happened in fulfilment of these words in the Prophet--

title: Matthew 21:5
text: 'Say to the daughter of Zion--"Behold, thy King is coming to thee, Gentle, and riding on an ass, And on the foal of a beast of burden."'

title: Matthew 21:6
text: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.

title: Matthew 21:7
text: They led the ass and the foal back, and, when they had put their cloaks on them, he seated himself upon them.

title: Matthew 21:8
text: The immense crowd of people spread their cloaks in the road, while some cut branches off the trees, and spread them on the road.

title: Matthew 21:9
text: The crowds that led the way, as well as those that followed behind, kept shouting: "God save the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! God save him from on high!"

title: Matthew 21:10
text: When he had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred, and asked--

title: Matthew 21:11
text: "Who is this?", to which the crowd replied--"This is the Prophet Jesus from Nazareth in Galilee."

title: Matthew 21:12
text: Jesus went into the Temple Courts, and drove out all those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of the pigeon-dealers,

title: Matthew 21:13
text: And said to them: "Scripture says--"My House shall be called a house of prayer'; but you are making it 'a den of robbers.'"

title: Matthew 21:14
text: While he was still in the Temple Courts, some blind and some lame people came up to him, and he cured them.

title: Matthew 21:15
text: But, when the Chief Priests and the Teachers of the Law saw the wonderful things that Jesus did, and the boys who were calling out in the Temple Courts "God save the Son of David!", they were indignant,

title: Matthew 21:16
text: And said to him: "Do you hear what these boys are saying?" "Yes," answered Jesus; "but did you never read the words--'Out of the mouths of babes and sucklings thou hast called forth perfect praise'?"

title: Matthew 21:17
text: Then he left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.

title: Matthew 21:18
text: The next morning, in returning to the city, Jesus became hungry;

title: Matthew 21:19
text: And, noticing a solitary fig tree by the road-side, he went up to it, but found nothing on it but leaves. So he said to it: "Never again shall fruit be gathered off you." And suddenly the fruit tree withered up.

title: Matthew 21:20
text: When the disciples saw this, they exclaimed in astonishment: "How suddenly the fig tree withered up!"

title: Matthew 21:21
text: "I tell you," replied Jesus, "if you have faith, without ever a doubt, you will do what not only what has been done to the fig tree, but, even if you should say to this hill 'Be lifted up and hurled into the sea!' it would be done.

title: Matthew 21:22
text: And whatever you ask for in your prayers will, if you have faith, be granted you."

title: Matthew 21:23
text: After Jesus had come into the Temple Courts, the Chief Priests and the Councillors of the Nation came up to him as he was teaching, and said: " What authority have you to do these things? Who gave you this authority?"

title: Matthew 21:24
text: "I, too," said Jesus in reply, "will ask you one question; if you will give me an answer to it, then I, also, will tell you what authority I have to act as I do.

title: Matthew 21:25
text: It is about John's baptism. What was its origin? divine or human?" But they began arguing among themselves: "If we say 'divine,' he will say to us 'Why then did not you believe him?'

title: Matthew 21:26
text: But if we say 'human,' we are afraid of the people, for every one regards John as a Prophet."

title: Matthew 21:27
text: So the answer they gave Jesus was--"We do not know." "Then I," he said, "refuse to tell you what authority I have to do these things.

title: Matthew 21:28
text: What do you think of this? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the elder and said 'Go and work in the vineyard to-day my son.'

title: Matthew 21:29
text: 'Yes, sir,' he answered; but he did not go.

title: Matthew 21:30
text: Then the father went to the second son, and said the same. 'I will not,' he answered; but afterwards he was sorry and went.

title: Matthew 21:31
text: Which of the two sons did as his father wished?" " The second, "they said. "I tell you," added Jesus, "that tax-gatherers and prostitutes are going into the Kingdom of God before you.

title: Matthew 21:32
text: For when John came to you, walking in the path of righteousness, you did not believe him, but tax-gatherers and prostitutes did; and yet you, though you saw this, even then were not sorry, nor did you believe him.

title: Matthew 21:33
text: Listen to another parable. A man, who was an employer, once planted a vineyard, put a fence round it, dug a winepress in it, built a tower, and then let it out to tenants and went abroad.

title: Matthew 21:34
text: When the time for the vintage drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants, to receive his share of the produce.

title: Matthew 21:35
text: But the tenants seized his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

title: Matthew 21:36
text: A second time the owner sent some servants, a larger number than before, and the tenants treated them in the same way.

title: Matthew 21:37
text: As a last resource he sent his son to them. 'They will respect my son,' he said.

title: Matthew 21:38
text: But the tenants, on seeing his son, said to each other 'Here is the heir! Come, let us kill him, and get his inheritance.'

title: Matthew 21:39
text: So they seized him, and threw him outside the vineyard, and killed him.

title: Matthew 21:40
text: Now, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"

title: Matthew 21:41
text: "Miserable wretches!" they exclaimed, "he will put them to a miserable death, and he will let out the vineyard to other tenants, who will pay him his share of the produce at the proper times."

title: Matthew 21:42
text: Then Jesus added: "Have you never read in the Scriptures?-- 'The very stone which the builders despised--Has now itself become the corner-stone; This corner-stone has come from the Lord, And is marvelous in our eyes.'

title: Matthew 21:43
text: And that, I tell you, is why the Kingdom of God will be taken from you, and given to a nation that does produce the fruit of the Kingdom.

title: Matthew 21:44
text: Yes, and he who falls on this stone will be dashed to pieces, while any one on whom it falls--it will scatter him as dust."

title: Matthew 21:45
text: After listening to these parables, the Chief Priests and the Pharisees saw that it was about them that he was speaking;

title: Matthew 21:46
text: Yet, although eager to arrest him, they were afraid of the crowds, who regarded him as a Prophet.

title: Matthew 22:1
text: Once more Jesus spoke to them in parables.

title: Matthew 22:2
text: "The Kingdom of Heaven," he said, "may be compared to a king who gave a banquet in honor of his son's wedding.

title: Matthew 22:3
text: He sent his servants to call those who had been invited to the banquet, but they were unwilling to come.

title: Matthew 22:4
text: A second time he sent some servants, with orders to say to those who had been invited 'I have prepared my breakfast, my cattle and fat beasts are killed and everything is ready; come to the banquet.'

title: Matthew 22:5
text: They, however, took no notice, but went off, one to his farm, another to his business;

title: Matthew 22:6
text: While the rest, seizing his servants, ill-treated them and killed them.

title: Matthew 22:7
text: The king, in anger, sent his troops, put those murderers to death, and set their city on fire.

title: Matthew 22:8
text: Then he said to his servants 'The banquet is prepared, but those who were invited were not worthy.

title: Matthew 22:9
text: So go to the cross-roads, and invite everyone you find to the banquet.'

title: Matthew 22:10
text: The servants went out into the roads and collected all the people whom they found, whether bad or good; and the bridal-hall was filled with guests.

title: Matthew 22:11
text: But, when the king went in to see his guests, he noticed there a man who had not put on a wedding-robe.

title: Matthew 22:12
text: So he said to him 'My friend, how is it that you came in here without a wedding-robe?' The man was speechless.

title: Matthew 22:13
text: Then the king said to the attendants 'Tie him hand and foot, and 'put him out into the darkness' outside, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.'

title: Matthew 22:14
text: For many are called, but few chosen."

title: Matthew 22:15
text: Then the Pharisees went away and conferred together as to how they might lay a snare for Jesus in the course of conversation.

title: Matthew 22:16
text: They sent their disciples, with the Herodians, to say to him: "Teacher, we know that you are an honest man, and that you teach the way of God honestly, and are not afraid of any one; for you pay no regard to a man's position.

title: Matthew 22:17
text: Tell us, then, what you think. Are we right in paying taxes to the Emperor, or not?"

title: Matthew 22:18
text: Perceiving their malice, Jesus answered: "Why are you testing me, you hypocrites?

title: Matthew 22:19
text: Show me the coin with which the tax is paid. "And, when they had brought him a florin,

title: Matthew 22:20
text: He asked: "Whose head and title are these?"

title: Matthew 22:21
text: "The Emperor's," they answered: on which he said to them: "Then pay to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and to God what belongs to God."

title: Matthew 22:22
text: They wondered at his answer, and left him alone and went away.

title: Matthew 22:23
text: That same day some Sadducees came up to Jesus, maintaining that there is no resurrection. Their question was this:--

title: Matthew 22:24
text: "Teacher, Moses said--'Should a man die without children, the man's brother shall become the husband of the widow, and raise a family for his brother.'

title: Matthew 22:25
text: Now we had living among us seven brothers; of whom the eldest married and died, and, as he had no family, left his wife for his brother.

title: Matthew 22:26
text: The same thing happened to the second and the third brothers, and indeed to all the seven.

title: Matthew 22:27
text: The woman herself died last of all.

title: Matthew 22:28
text: At the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be out of the seven, all of them having had her?"

title: Matthew 22:29
text: "Your mistake," replied Jesus, "is due to your ignorance of the Scriptures, and of the power of God.

title: Matthew 22:30
text: For at the resurrection there is no marrying or being married, but all who rise are as angels in Heaven.

title: Matthew 22:31
text: As to the resurrection of the dead, have you not read these words of God--

title: Matthew 22:32
text: 'I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? He is not the God of dead men, but of living."

title: Matthew 22:33
text: The crowds, who had been listening to him, were greatly struck with his teaching.

title: Matthew 22:34
text: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they collected together.

title: Matthew 22:35
text: Then one of them, a Student of the Law, to test him, asked this question--

title: Matthew 22:36
text: "Teacher, what is the great commandment in the Law?"

title: Matthew 22:37
text: His answer was: "'Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy Heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.'

title: Matthew 22:38
text: This is the great first commandment.

title: Matthew 22:39
text: The second, which is like it, is this--'Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thou dost thyself.'

title: Matthew 22:40
text: On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets."

title: Matthew 22:41
text: Before the Pharisees separated, Jesus put this question to them--

title: Matthew 22:42
text: "What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?   "David's," they said.

title: Matthew 22:43
text: "How is it, then," Jesus replied, "that David, speaking under inspiration, calls him 'lord,' in the passage-

title: Matthew 22:44
text: 'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand, Until I put thy enemies beneath thy feet"'?

title: Matthew 22:45
text: Since, then, David calls him 'lord,' how is he David's son?"

title: Matthew 22:46
text: No one could say a word in answer; nor did any one after that day venture to question him further. 23:1 Then Jesus, speaking to the crowds and to his disciples, said:

title: Matthew 23:1
text: Then Jesus speaking to the crowds and to his disciples, said:

title: Matthew 23:2
text: "The teachers of the Law and the Pharisees now occupy the chair of Moses.

title: Matthew 23:3
text: Therefore practice and lay to heart everything that they tell preach but do not practice.

title: Matthew 23:4
text: While they make up heavy loads and pile them on other men's shoulder's they decline, themselves, to lift a finger to move them.

title: Matthew 23:5
text: All their actions are done to attract attention. They widen their phylacteries, and increase the size of their tassels,

title: Matthew 23:6
text: and like to have the place of honor at dinner, and the best seats in the Synagogues,

title: Matthew 23:7
text: and to be greeted in the markets with respect, and to be called 'Rabbi' for everybody.

title: Matthew 23:8
text: But do not allow yourselves to be called 'Rabbi,' for you have only one Father, the heavenly Father.

title: Matthew 23:9
text: And do not call any one Father, the heavenly Father.

title: Matthew 23:10
text: Nor must you allow yourselves to be called 'Leaders,' for you have only one Leader, the Christ.

title: Matthew 23:11
text: The man who would be the greatest among you must be your servant.

title: Matthew 23:12
text: Whoever shall exalt himself will be humbled, and whoever shall humble himself will be exalted.

title: Matthew 23:13
text: But alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You turn the key of the Kingdom of Heaven in men's faces. For you do not go in yourselves, nor yet allow those who try to go in to do so.

title: Matthew 23:14
text: Alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You destroy widow's houses, even while pretending to make long prayers; therefore you shall receive greater condemnation.

title: Matthew 23:15
text: Alas for you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You scour land and sea to make a single convert, and, when he is gained, you make him twice as deserving of the Pit as you are yourselves.

title: Matthew 23:16
text: Alas for you, you blind guides! You say 'if any answer by the Temple, his oath counts for nothing; but, if any one swears by the gold of the Temple, his oath is binding him'!

title: Matthew 23:17
text: Fools that you are and blind! Which is the more important? The gold? Or the Temple which has given sacredness to the gold?

title: Matthew 23:18
text: You say, too, 'If any one swears by the altar, his oath counts for nothing, but, if any one swears by the offering placed on it, his oath is binding on him'!

title: Matthew 23:19
text: Blind indeed! Which is the more important? The offering? or the altar which gives sacredness to the offering?

title: Matthew 23:20
text: Therefor a man, swearing by the altar, swears by it and by all that is on it,

title: Matthew 23:21
text: and a man, swearing by the Temple, swears by it and by him who dwells in it,

title: Matthew 23:22
text: while a man, swearing by Heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits upon it.

title: Matthew 23:23
text: Alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You pay tithes on mint, fennel, and caraway seed, and have neglected the weightier matters of the Law--justice, mercy, and good faith. These last you ought to have put into practice, without neglecting the first.

title: Matthew 23:24
text: You blind guides, to strain out a gnat and to swallow a camel!

title: Matthew 23:25
text: Alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside they are filled with the results of greed and self-indulgence.

title: Matthew 23:26
text: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and the dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.

title: Matthew 23:27
text: Alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You are like whitewashed tombs, which indeed look fair outside, while inside they are filled with dead men's bones and all kinds of filth.

title: Matthew 23:28
text: It is the same with you. Outwardly, and to others, you have the look of religious men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and sin.

title: Matthew 23:29
text: Alas for you, Teachers of the Law and Pharisees, hypocrites that you are! You build the tombs of the Prophets, and decorate the monuments of religious men,

title: Matthew 23:30
text: and say 'Had we been living in the days of our ancestors, we should have taken part in their murder of the Prophets!

title: Matthew 23:31
text: By doing this you are furnishing evidence against yourselves that you are true children of the men who murdered the Prophets.

title: Matthew 23:32
text: Fill up the measure of your ancestor's guilt.

title: Matthew 23:33
text: You serpents and brood of vipers! How can you escape being sentenced to the Pit?

title: Matthew 23:34
text: That is why I send you Prophets, wise men, and Teachers of the Law, some of whom you will crucify and kill, and some of whom you will scourge in your Synagogues, and persecute from town to town;

title: Matthew 23:35
text: in order that upon your heads may fall every drop of innocent 'blood split on earth,' from the blood of innocent Abel down to that of Zechariah, Barachiah's son, whom you murdered between the Temple and the altar.

title: Matthew 23:36
text: All this, I tell you, will come home to the present generation.

title: Matthew 23:37
text: Jerusalem! Jerusalem! She who slays the Prophets and stones the messengers sent to her--Oh, how often have I wished to gather your children round me, as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you would not came!

title: Matthew 23:38
text: Verily, your house is left to you desolate!

title: Matthew 23:39
text: For nevermore, I tell you, shall you see me, until you say--   'Blessed is He who comes in the Name of the Lord!'"

title: Matthew 24:1
text: Leaving the Temple Courts, Jesus was walking away, when his disciples came up to draw his attention to the Temple buildings.

title: Matthew 24:2
text: "Do you see all these things?" was his answer. "I tell you, not a single stone will be left here upon another, which will not be throne down,"

title: Matthew 24:3
text: So, while Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came up to him privately and said: "Tell us when this will be, and what will be the sign of your Coming, and of the close of the age."

title: Matthew 24:4
text: Jesus replied to them as follows:   "See that no one leads you astray;

title: Matthew 24:5
text: for, many will take my name, and come saying 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

title: Matthew 24:6
text: And you will hear of wars and rumors of wars; take care not to be alarmed, for such things must occur; but the end is not yet here.

title: Matthew 24:7
text: For 'nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom,' and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

title: Matthew 24:8
text: All this, however, will be but the beginning of the birth pangs!

title: Matthew 24:9
text: When that time comes, they will give you up to persecution, and will put you to death, and you will be hated by all nations on account of my Name.

title: Matthew 24:10
text: And then many will fall away, and will betray one another, and hate one another.

title: Matthew 24:11
text: Many false Prophets, also, will appear and lead many astray;

title: Matthew 24:12
text: and, owing to the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.

title: Matthew 24:13
text: Yet the man that endures to the end shall be saved.

title: Matthew 24:14
text: And this Good News of the Kingdom shall be proclaimed throughout the world as a witness to all nations; and then will come the end.

title: Matthew 24:15
text: As soon, then, as you see 'the Foul Desecration,' mentioned by the Prophet Daniel, standing in the Holy Place," (the reader must consider what this means)

title: Matthew 24:16
text: "then those of you who are in Judea must take refuge in the mountains;

title: Matthew 24:17
text: and a man on the housetop must not go down to get the things that are in his house;

title: Matthew 24:18
text: nor must one who is on his farm turn back to get his cloak.

title: Matthew 24:19
text: And alas for the women that are with child, and for those that are nursing infants in those days!

title: Matthew 24:20
text: Pray, too, that your flight may not take place in winter, nor on a Sabbath;

title: Matthew 24:21
text: for that will be 'a time of great distress, the like of which has not occurred from the beginning of the world down to the present time'--no, nor ever will again.

title: Matthew 24:22
text: And had not those days been limited, not a single soul would escape; but for the sake of 'God's People' a limit will be put to them.

title: Matthew 24:23
text: And, at that time, if any one should say to you 'Look! here is the Christ!' or 'Here he is!', do not believe it;

title: Matthew 24:24
text: For false Christs and false Prophets will arise, and will display great signs and marvels, so that, were it possible, even God's People would be led astray.

title: Matthew 24:25
text: Remember, I have told you beforehand.

title: Matthew 24:26
text: Therefore, if people say to you 'He is in the Wilderness!', do not go out there; or 'He is in an inner room!', do not believe it;

title: Matthew 24:27
text: For, just as lightning will start from the east and flash across to the west, so will it be with the Coming of the Son of Man.

title: Matthew 24:28
text: Wherever a dead body lies, there will the vultures flock.'

title: Matthew 24:29
text: Immediately after the distress of those days, 'the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give her light, the stars will fall from the heavens,' and 'the forces of the heavens will be convulsed.'

title: Matthew 24:30
text: Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in the heavens; and all the peoples of the earth will mourn, when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the heavens,' with power and great glory;

title: Matthew 24:31
text: And he will send his angels, with a great trumpet, and they will gather his People round him from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

title: Matthew 24:32
text: Learn the lesson taught by the fig tree. As soon as its branches are full of sap, and it is bursting into leaf, you know that summer is near.

title: Matthew 24:33
text: And so may you, as soon as you see all these things, know that he is at your doors.

title: Matthew 24:34
text: I tell you, even the present generation will not pass away, till all these things have taken place.

title: Matthew 24:35
text: The heavens and the earth will pass away, but my words shall never pass away.

title: Matthew 24:36
text: But about that Day and Hour, no one knows--not even the angels of Heaven, nor yet the Son--but only the Father himself.

title: Matthew 24:37
text: For, just as in the days of Noah, so will it be at the Coming of the Son of Man.

title: Matthew 24:38
text: In those days before the flood they went on eating and drinking, marrying and being married, up to the very day on which Noah entered the ark,

title: Matthew 24:39
text: Taking not notice till the flood came and swept them one and all away; and so will it be at the Coming of the Son of Man.

title: Matthew 24:40
text: At that time, of two men on a farm one will be taken and one left;

title: Matthew 24:41
text: Of two women grinding with the hand-mill one will be taken and one left.

title: Matthew 24:42
text: Therefore watch; for you cannot be sure on what day your Master is coming.

title: Matthew 24:43
text: But this you do know, that, had the owner of the house known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have been on the watch, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

title: Matthew 24:44
text: Therefore, do you also prepare, since it is just when you are least expecting him that the Son of Man will come.

title: Matthew 24:45
text: Who, then is that trustworthy, careful servant, who has been placed by his master over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?

title: Matthew 24:46
text: Happy will that servant be whom his master, when he comes home, shall find doing this.

title: Matthew 24:47
text: I tell you that his master will put him in charge of the whole of his property.

title: Matthew 24:48
text: But, should he be a bad servant, and say to himself 'My master is a long time in coming,'

title: Matthew 24:49
text: And begin to beat his fellow-servants, and eat and drink with drunkards,

title: Matthew 24:50
text: That servant's master will come on a day when he does not expect him, and at an hour of which he is unaware,

title: Matthew 24:51
text: And will flog him severely, and assign him his place among the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

title: Matthew 25:1
text: Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten bridesmaids who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

title: Matthew 25:2
text: Five of them were foolish, and five were prudent.

title: Matthew 25:3
text: The foolish ones took their lamps, but took no oil with them;

title: Matthew 25:4
text: While the prudent ones, besides taking their lamps, took oil in their jars.

title: Matthew 25:5
text: As the bridegroom was late in coming, they all became drowsy, and slept.

title: Matthew 25:6
text: But at midnight a shout was raised--'The Bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!'

title: Matthew 25:7
text: Then all the bridesmaids awoke and trimmed their lamps.

title: Matthew 25:8
text: And the foolish said to the prudent 'Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.'

title: Matthew 25:9
text: But the prudent ones answered 'No, for fear that there will not be enough for you and for us. Go instead to those who sell it, and buy for yourselves.'

title: Matthew 25:10
text: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom came; and the bridesmaids who were ready went in with him to the banquet, and the door was shut.

title: Matthew 25:11
text: Afterwards the other bridesmaids came. 'Sir, Sir,' they said, 'open the door to us!'

title: Matthew 25:12
text: But the bridegroom answered 'I tell you, I do not know you.'

title: Matthew 25:13
text: Therefore watch, since you know neither the Day nor the Hour.

title: Matthew 25:14
text: For it is as though a man, going on his travels, called his servants, and gave his property into their charge.

title: Matthew 25:15
text: He gave three thousand pounds to one, twelve hundred to another, and six hundred to a third, in proportion to the ability of each. Then he set out on his travels.

title: Matthew 25:16
text: The man who had received the three thousand pounds went at once and traded with it, and made another three thousand.

title: Matthew 25:17
text: So, too, the man who had received the twelve hundred pounds made another twelve hundred.

title: Matthew 25:18
text: But the man who had received the six hundred went and dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master's money.

title: Matthew 25:19
text: After a long time the master of those servants returned, and settled accounts with them.

title: Matthew 25:20
text: The man who had received the three thousand pounds came up and brought three thousand more. 'Sir,' he said, 'you entrusted me with three thousand pounds; look, I have made another three thousand!'

title: Matthew 25:21
text: 'Well done, good, trustworthy servant!' said his master. 'You have been trustworthy with a small sum; now I will place a large one in your hands; come and share your master's joy!'

title: Matthew 25:22
text: Then the one who had received the twelve hundred pounds came up and said 'Sir, you entrusted me with twelve hundred pounds; look, I have made another twelve hundred!'

title: Matthew 25:23
text: 'Well done, good, trustworthy servant!' said his master. 'You have been trustworthy with a small sum; now I will place a large one in your hands; come and share your master's joy!'

title: Matthew 25:24
text: The man who had received the six hundred pounds came up, too, and said 'Sir, I knew that you were a hard man; you reap where you have not sown, and gather up where you have not winnowed;

title: Matthew 25:25
text: And, in my fear, I went and hid your money in the ground; look, here is what belongs to you!'

title: Matthew 25:26
text: 'You lazy, worthless servant!' was his master's reply. 'You knew that I reap where I have not sown, and gather up where I have not winnowed?

title: Matthew 25:27
text: Then you ought to have placed my money in the hands of bankers, and I, on my return, should have received my money, with interest.

title: Matthew 25:28
text: 'Therefore,' he continued, 'take away from him the six hundred pounds, and give it to the one who has the six thousand.

title: Matthew 25:29
text: For, to him who has, more will be given, and he shall have abundance; but, as for him who has nothing, even what he has will be taken away from him.

title: Matthew 25:30
text: As for the useless servant, 'put him out into the darkness' outside, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.'

title: Matthew 25:31
text: When the Son of Man has come in his glory and all the angels with him, then he 'will take his seat on his throne of glory';

title: Matthew 25:32
text: And all the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people--just as a shepherd separates sheep from goats- -

title: Matthew 25:33
text: Placing the sheep on his right hand, and the goats on his left.

title: Matthew 25:34
text: Then the King will say to those on his right 'Come, you who are blessed by my Father, enter upon possession of the Kingdom prepared for you ever since the beginning of the world.

title: Matthew 25:35
text: For, when I was hungry, you gave me food; when I was thirsty, you gave me drink; when I was a stranger, you took me to your homes;

title: Matthew 25:36
text: When I was naked, you clothed me; when I fell ill, you visited me; and when I was in prison, you came to me.'

title: Matthew 25:37
text: Then the Righteous will answer 'Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you? Or thirsty, and give you a drink?

title: Matthew 25:38
text: When did we see you a stranger, and take you to our homes? Or naked, and clothe you?

title: Matthew 25:39
text: When did we see you ill, or in prison, and come to you?'

title: Matthew 25:40
text: And the King will reply 'I tell you, as often as you did it to one of these my Brothers, however lowly, you did it to me.'

title: Matthew 25:41
text: Then he will say to those on his left 'Go from my presence, accursed, into the 'aeonian fire which has been prepared for the Devil and his angels.'

title: Matthew 25:42
text: For, when I was hungry, you gave me no food; when I was thirsty, you gave me no drink;

title: Matthew 25:43
text: When I was a stranger, you did not take me to your homes; when I was naked, you did not clothe me; and, when I was ill and in prison, you did not visit me.'

title: Matthew 25:44
text: Then they, in their turn, will answer 'Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or ill, or in prison, and did not supply your wants?'

title: Matthew 25:45
text: And then he will reply 'I tell you, as often as you failed to do it to one of these, however lowly, you failed to do it to me.'

title: Matthew 25:46
text: And these last will go away 'into aeonian punishment,' but the righteous 'into aeonian life.'"

title: Matthew 26:1
text: When Jesus had finished all this teaching, he said to his disciples:

title: Matthew 26:2
text: "You know that in two days time the Festival of the Passover will be here; and that the Son of Man is to be given up to be crucified."

title: Matthew 26:3
text: Then the Chief Priests and the Councillors of the Nation met in the house of the High Priest, who was called Caiaphas,

title: Matthew 26:4
text: And plotted together to arrest Jesus by stealth and put him to death;

title: Matthew 26:5
text: But they said: "Not during the Festival, for fear of causing a riot."

title: Matthew 26:6
text: After Jesus had reached Bethany, and while he was in the house of Simon the leper,

title: Matthew 26:7
text: a woman came up to him with an alabaster jar of very costly perfume, and poured the perfume upon his head as he was at table.

title: Matthew 26:8
text: The disciples were indignant at seeing this. "What is this waste for?" they exclaimed.

title: Matthew 26:9
text: "It could have been sold for a large sum, and the money given to poor people."

title: Matthew 26:10
text: "Why are you troubling the woman?" Jesus said, when he noticed it. "For this is a beautiful deed that she has done to me.

title: Matthew 26:11
text: You always have the poor with you, but you will not always have me.

title: Matthew 26:12
text: In pouring this perfume on my body, she has done it for my burying.

title: Matthew 26:13
text: I tell you, wherever, in the whole world, this Good News is proclaimed, what this woman has done will be told in memory of her."

title: Matthew 26:14
text: It was then that one of the Twelve, named Judas Iscariot, made his way to the Chief Priests,

title: Matthew 26:15
text: And said "What are you willing to give me, if I betray Jesus to you?" The Priests 'weighed him out thirty pieces of silver' as payment.

title: Matthew 26:16
text: So from that time Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.

title: Matthew 26:17
text: On the first day of the Festival of the Unleavened Bread, the disciples came up to Jesus, and said: "Where do you wish us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"

title: Matthew 26:18
text: "Go into the city to a certain man," he answered, "and say to him 'The Teacher says--My time is near. I will keep the Passover with my disciples at your house.'"

title: Matthew 26:19
text: The disciples did as Jesus directed them, and prepared the Passover.

title: Matthew 26:20
text: In the evening Jesus took his place with the twelve disciples,

title: Matthew 26:21
text: And, while they were eating, he said: "I tell you that one of you will betray me."

title: Matthew 26:22
text: In great grief they began to say to him, one by one: "Can it be I, Master?"

title: Matthew 26:23
text: "The one who dipped his bread beside me in the dish," replied Jesus, "is the one who will betray me.

title: Matthew 26:24
text: True, the Son of Man must go, as Scripture says of him, yet alas for that man by whom the Son of Man is being betrayed! For that man 'it would be better never to have been born!'"

title: Matthew 26:25
text: And Judas, who was betraying him, turned to him and said: "Can it be I, Rabbi?" "It is," answered Jesus.

title: Matthew 26:26
text: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread, and, after saying the blessing, broke it and, as he gave it to his disciples, said: "Take it and eat it; this is my body."

title: Matthew 26:27
text: Then he took a cup, and, after saying the thanksgiving, gave it to them, with the words: "Drink from it, all of you;

title: Matthew 26:28
text: For this is my Covenant blood, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

title: Matthew 26:29
text: And I tell you that I shall never, after this, drink of this juice of the grape, until that day when I shall drink it new with you in the Kingdom of my Father."

title: Matthew 26:30
text: They then sang a hymn, and went out to the Mount of Olives.

title: Matthew 26:31
text: Then Jesus said to them: "Even you will all fall away from me to-night. Scripture says--'I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

title: Matthew 26:32
text: But, after I have risen, I shall go before you into Galilee."

title: Matthew 26:33
text: "If every one else falls away from you," Peter answered, "I shall never fall away!"

title: Matthew 26:34
text: "I tell you," replied Jesus, "that this very night, before the cock crows, you will disown me three times!"

title: Matthew 26:35
text: "Even if I must die with you," Peter exclaimed, "I shall never disown you!" All the disciples spoke in the same way.

title: Matthew 26:36
text: Then Jesus came with them to a garden called Gethsemane, and he said to his disciples: " Sit down here while I go and pray yonder."

title: Matthew 26:37
text: Taking with him Peter and the two sons of Zebediah, he began to show signs of sadness and deep distress of mind.

title: Matthew 26:38
text: "I am sad at heart," he said, "sad even to death; wait here and watch with me."

title: Matthew 26:39
text: Going on a little further, he threw himself on his face in prayer. "My Father," he said, "if it is possible, let me be spared this cup; only, not as I will, but as thou willest."

title: Matthew 26:40
text: Then he came to his disciples, and found them asleep. "What!" he said to Peter, "could none of you watch with me for one hour?

title: Matthew 26:41
text: Watch and pray, that you may not fall into temptation. True, the spirit is eager, but human nature is weak."

title: Matthew 26:42
text: Again, a second time, he went away, and prayed. "My Father," he said, "if I cannot be spared this cup, but must drink it, thy will be done!"

title: Matthew 26:43
text: And coming back again he found them asleep, for their eyes were heavy.

title: Matthew 26:44
text: So he left them, and went away again, and prayed a third time, again saying the same words.

title: Matthew 26:45
text: Then he came to the disciples, and said: "Sleep on now, and rest yourselves. Hark! my time is close at hand, and the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of wicked men.

title: Matthew 26:46
text: Up, and let us be going. Look! my betrayer is close at hand."

title: Matthew 26:47
text: And, while he was still speaking, Judas, who was one of the Twelve, came in sight; and with him was a great crowd of people, with swords and clubs, sent from the Chief Priests and Councillors of the Nation.

title: Matthew 26:48
text: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them. "The man whom I kiss," he had said, "will be the one; arrest him."

title: Matthew 26:49
text: So he went up to Jesus at once, and exclaimed: "Welcome, Rabbi!" and kissed him;

title: Matthew 26:50
text: On which Jesus said to him: "Friend, do what you have come for." Thereupon the men went up, seized Jesus, and arrested him.

title: Matthew 26:51
text: Suddenly one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and striking the High Priest's servant, cut off his ear.

title: Matthew 26:52
text: "Sheathe your sword," Jesus said, "for all who draw the sword will be put to the sword.

title: Matthew 26:53
text: Do you think that I cannot ask my Father for help, when he would at once send to my aid more than twelve legions of angels?

title: Matthew 26:54
text: But in that case how would the Scriptures be fulfilled, which say that this must be?"

title: Matthew 26:55
text: Jesus at the same time said to the crowds: "Have you come out, as if after a robber, with swords and clubs, to take me? I have sat teaching day after day in the Temple Courts, and yet you did not arrest me."

title: Matthew 26:56
text: The whole of this occurred in fulfillment of the Prophetic Scriptures. Then the disciples all forsook him and fled.

title: Matthew 26:57
text: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas, the High Priest, where the Teachers of the Law and the Councillors had assembled.

title: Matthew 26:58
text: Peter followed him at a distance as far as the courtyard of the offices, to see the end.

title: Matthew 26:59
text: Meanwhile the Chief Priests and the whole of the High Council were trying to get such false evidence against Jesus, as would warrant putting him to death,

title: Matthew 26:60
text: But they did not find any, although many came forward with false evidence. Later on, however, two men came forward and said:

title: Matthew 26:61
text: "This man said 'I am able to destroy the Temple of God, and to build it in three days.'"

title: Matthew 26:62
text: Then the High Priest stood up, and said to Jesus: "Have you no answer? What is this evidence which these men are giving against you?"

title: Matthew 26:63
text: But Jesus remained silent. On this the High Priest said to him: "I adjure you, by the Living God, to tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God."

title: Matthew 26:64
text: "It is true," Jesus answered; "Moreover I tell you all that hereafter you shall 'see the Son of Man sitting on the right hand of the Almighty, and coming on the clouds of the heavens.'"

title: Matthew 26:65
text: Then the High Priest tore his robes. "This is blasphemy!" he exclaimed. "Why do we want any more witnesses? You have just heard his blasphemy!

title: Matthew 26:66
text: What is your decision?" They answered: "He deserves death."

title: Matthew 26:67
text: Then they spat in his face, and struck him, while others dealt blows at him, saying as they did so:

title: Matthew 26:68
text: "Now play the Prophet for us, you Christ! Who was it that struck you?"

title: Matthew 26:69
text: Peter, meanwhile, was sitting outside in the courtyard; and a maidservant came up to him, and exclaimed: "Why, you were with Jesus the Galilean!"

title: Matthew 26:70
text: But Peter denied it before them all. "I do not know what you mean," he replied.

title: Matthew 26:71
text: When he had gone out into the gateway, another maid saw him, and said to those who were there: "This man was with Jesus of Nazareth!"

title: Matthew 26:72
text: Again he denied it with an oath: "I do not know the man!"

title: Matthew 26:73
text: But soon afterwards those who were standing by came up and said to Peter: "You also are certainly one of them; why, your very way of speaking proves it!"

title: Matthew 26:74
text: Then Peter began to swear, with most solemn imprecations: "I do not know the man." At that moment a cock crowed;

title: Matthew 26:75
text: and Peter remembered the words which Jesus had said--'Before a cock has crowed, you will disown me three times'; and he went outside, and wept bitterly.

title: Matthew 27:1
text: At daybreak all the Chief Priests and the Councillors of the Nation consulted together against Jesus, to bring about his death.

title: Matthew 27:2
text: They put him in chains and led him away, and gave him up to the Roman Governor, Pilate.

title: Matthew 27:3
text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, seeing that Jesus was condemned, repented of what he had done, and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the Chief Priests and Councillors.

title: Matthew 27:4
text: "I did wrong in betraying a good man to his death," he said. "What has that to do with us?" they replied. "You must see to that yourself."

title: Matthew 27:5
text: Judas flung down the pieces of silver in the Temple, and left; and went away and hanged himself.

title: Matthew 27:6
text: The Chief Priests took the pieces of silver, but they said: "We must not put them into the Temple treasury, because they are blood-money."

title: Matthew 27:7
text: So, after consultation, they bought with them the 'Potter's Field' for a burial-ground for foreigners;

title: Matthew 27:8
text: And that is why that field is called the 'Field of Blood' to this very day.

title: Matthew 27:9
text: Then it was that these words spoken by the Prophet Jeremiah were fulfilled-- 'They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him who was valued, whom some of the people of Israel valued,

title: Matthew 27:10
text: And gave them for the Potter's field, as the Lord commanded me.'

title: Matthew 27:11
text: Meanwhile Jesus was brought before the Roman Governor. "Are you the King of the Jews?" asked the Governor. "It is true," answered Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:12
text: While charges were being brought against him by the Chief Priests and Councillors, Jesus made no reply.

title: Matthew 27:13
text: Then Pilate said to him: "Do not you hear how many accusations they are making against you?"

title: Matthew 27:14
text: Yet Jesus made no reply--not even a single word; at which the Governor was greatly astonished.

title: Matthew 27:15
text: Now, at the Feast, the Governor was accustomed to grant the people the release of any one prisoner whom they might choose.

title: Matthew 27:16
text: At that time they had a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:17
text: So, when the people had collected, Pilate said to them: "Which do you wish me to release for you? Barabbas? Or Jesus who is called 'Christ'?"

title: Matthew 27:18
text: For he knew that it was out of jealousy that they had given Jesus up to him.

title: Matthew 27:19
text: While he was still on the Bench, his wife sent this message to him--"Do not have anything to do with that good man, for I have been very unhappy to-day in a dream on account of him."

title: Matthew 27:20
text: But the Chief Priests and the Councillors persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas, and to kill Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:21
text: The Governor, however, said to them: "Which of these two do you wish me to release for you?" "Barabbas," they answered.

title: Matthew 27:22
text: "What then," Pilate asked, "shall I do with Jesus who is called 'Christ'?" "Let him be crucified," they all replied.

title: Matthew 27:23
text: "Why, what harm has he done?" he asked. But they kept shouting furiously: "Let him be crucified!"

title: Matthew 27:24
text: When Pilate saw that his efforts were unavailing, but that, on the contrary, a riot was beginning, he took some water, and washed his hands in the sight of the crowd, saying as he did so: "I am not answerable for this bloodshed; you must see to it yourselves."

title: Matthew 27:25
text: And all the people answered: "His blood be on our heads and on our children's!"

title: Matthew 27:26
text: The Pilate released Barabbas to them; but Jesus he scourged, and gave him up to be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:27
text: After that, the Governor's soldiers took Jesus with them into the Government House, and gathered the whole garrison round him.

title: Matthew 27:28
text: They stripped him, and put on him a red military cloak,

title: Matthew 27:29
text: And having twisted some thorns into a crown, put it on his head, and a rod in his right hand, and then, going down on their knees before him, they mocked him. "Long life to you, King of the Jews!" they said.

title: Matthew 27:30
text: They spat at him and, taking the rod, kept striking him on the head;

title: Matthew 27:31
text: And, when they had left off mocking him, they took off the military cloak, and put his own clothes on him, and led him away to be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:32
text: As they were on their way out, they came upon a man from Cyrene of the name of Simon; and they compelled him to go with them to carry the cross.

title: Matthew 27:33
text: On reaching a place named Golgotha (a place named from its likeness to a skull),

title: Matthew 27:34
text: they gave him some wine to drink which had been mixed with gall; but after tasting it, Jesus refused to drink it.

title: Matthew 27:35
text: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothes among them by casting lots.

title: Matthew 27:36
text: Then they sat down, and kept watch over him there.

title: Matthew 27:37
text: Above his head they fixed the accusation against him written out--'THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.'

title: Matthew 27:38
text: At the same time two robbers were crucified with him, one on the right, the other on the left.

title: Matthew 27:39
text: The passers-by railed at him, shaking their heads as they said:

title: Matthew 27:40
text: "You who 'destroy the Temple and build one in three days,' save yourself! If you are God's Son, come down from the cross!"

title: Matthew 27:41
text: In the same way the Chief Priests, with the Teaches of the Law and Councillors, said in mockery:

title: Matthew 27:42
text: "He saved others, but he cannot save himself! He is the 'King of Israel'! Let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

title: Matthew 27:43
text: He has trusted in God; if God wants him, let him deliver him now; for he said 'I am God's Son.'"

title: Matthew 27:44
text: Even the robbers, who were crucified with him, reviled him in the same way.

title: Matthew 27:45
text: After mid-day a darkness came over all the country, lasting till three in the afternoon.

title: Matthew 27:46
text: And about three Jesus called out loudly: "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabacthani"--that is to say, 'O my God, my God, why has thou forsaken me?'

title: Matthew 27:47
text: Some of those standing by heard this, and said: "The man is calling for Elijah!"

title: Matthew 27:48
text: One of them immediately ran and took a sponge, and, filling it with common wine, put it on the end of a rod, and offered it to him to drink.

title: Matthew 27:49
text: But the rest said: "Wait and let us see if Elijah is coming to save him." [However another man took a spear, and pierced his side; and water and blood flowed from it.]

title: Matthew 27:50
text: But Jesus, uttering another loud cry, gave up his spirit.

title: Matthew 27:51
text: Suddenly the Temple curtain was torn in two from top to bottom, the earth shook, the rocks were torn asunder,

title: Matthew 27:52
text: the tombs opened, and the bodies of many of God's People who had fallen asleep rose,

title: Matthew 27:53
text: And they, leaving their tombs, went, after the resurrection of Jesus, into the Holy City, and appeared to many people.

title: Matthew 27:54
text: The Roman Captain, and the men with him who were watching Jesus, on seeing the earthquake and all that was happening, became greatly frightened and exclaimed: "This must indeed have been God's Son!"

title: Matthew 27:55
text: There were many women there, watching from a distance, who had accompanied Jesus from Galilee and had been attending on him.

title: Matthew 27:56
text: Among them were Mary of Magdala, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebediah's sons.

title: Matthew 27:57
text: When evening had fallen, there came a rich man belonging to Ramah, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:58
text: He went to see Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus; upon which Pilate ordered it to be given him.

title: Matthew 27:59
text: So Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen sheet,

title: Matthew 27:60
text: And laid it in his newly-made tomb which he had cut in the rock; and, before he left, he rolled a great stone against the entrance of the tomb.

title: Matthew 27:61
text: Mary of Magdala and the other Mary remained behind, sitting in front of the grave.

title: Matthew 27:62
text: The next day--that is, the day following the Preparation-Day- -the Chief Priests and Pharisees came in a body to Pilate, and said:

title: Matthew 27:63
text: "Sir, we remember that, during his lifetime, that impostor said 'I shall rise after three days.'

title: Matthew 27:64
text: So order the tomb to be made secure till the third day. Otherwise his disciples may come and steal him, and then say to the people 'He has risen from the dead,' when the latest imposture will be worse than the first."

title: Matthew 27:65
text: "You may have a guard," was Pilate's reply; "go and make the tomb as secure as you can."

title: Matthew 27:66
text: So they went made the tomb secure, by sealing the stone, in presence of the guard.

title: Matthew 28:1
text: After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary of Magdala and the other Mary had gone to look at the grave,

title: Matthew 28:2
text: When suddenly a great earthquake occurred. For an angel of the Lord descended from Heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and seated himself upon it.

title: Matthew 28:3
text: His appearance was as dazzling as lightning, and his clothing was as white as snow;

title: Matthew 28:4
text: And, in their terror of him, the men on guard trembled violently and became like dead men.

title: Matthew 28:5
text: But the angel, addressing the women, said; "You need not be afraid. I now that it is Jesus, who was crucified, for whom you are looking.

title: Matthew 28:6
text: He is not here; for he has risen, as he said he would. Come, and see the place where he was lying;

title: Matthew 28:7
text: And then go quickly and say to him disciples 'He has risen from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Remember, I have told you."

title: Matthew 28:8
text: On this they left the tomb quickly, in awe and great joy, and ran to tell the news to the disciples.

title: Matthew 28:9
text: Suddenly Jesus me them. "Welcome! he said. The women went up to him, and clasped his feet, bowing to the ground before him. Then Jesus said to them:

title: Matthew 28:10
text: "Do not be afraid; go and tell my brothers to set out for Galilee, and they shall see me there."

title: Matthew 28:11
text: While they were still on their way, some of the guard came into the city, and reported to the Chief Priests everything that had happened.

title: Matthew 28:12
text: So they and the Councillors met and, after holding a consultation, gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

title: Matthew 28:13
text: And told them to say that his disciples came in the night, and stole him while they were asleep;

title: Matthew 28:14
text: "And should this matter come before the Governor," they added, "we will satisfy him, and see that you have nothing to fear."

title: Matthew 28:15
text: So the soldiers took the money, and did as they were instructed. And this story has been current among the Jews from that day to this.

title: Matthew 28:16
text: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus told them to meet him;

title: Matthew 28:17
text: And, when they saw him, they bowed to the ground before him; although some felt doubtful.

title: Matthew 28:18
text: Then Jesus came up, and spoke to them thus: "All authority in heaven and on the earth has been given to me.

title: Matthew 28:19
text: Therefore go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the Faith of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit,

title: Matthew 28:20
text: And teaching them to lay to heart all the commands that I have given you; and, remember, I myself am with you every day until the close of the age."

title: Mark 1:1
text: The beginning of the Good News about Jesus Christ.

title: Mark 1:2
text: It is said in the Prophet Isaiah--'Behold! I send my Messenger before thy face; He shall prepare thy way.'

title: Mark 1:3
text: 'The voice of one crying aloud in the Wilderness: "Make ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight."'

title: Mark 1:4
text: And in fulfillment of this, John the Baptizer appeared in the Wilderness, proclaiming a baptism upon repentance, for the forgiveness of sins.

title: Mark 1:5
text: The whole of Judea, as well as all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, went out to him; and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

title: Mark 1:6
text: John was clad in clothing of camels' hair, with a belt of leather round his waist, and lived on locusts and wild honey;

title: Mark 1:7
text: And he proclaimed--"There is coming after me one more powerful than I, and I am not fit even to stoop down and unfasten his sandals.

title: Mark 1:8
text: I have baptized you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

title: Mark 1:9
text: Now about that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

title: Mark 1:10
text: And just as he was coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent apart, and the Spirit, like a dove, descending upon him,

title: Mark 1:11
text: And from the heavens came a voice--"Thou art my Son, the Beloved; in thee I delight."

title: Mark 1:12
text: Immediately afterwards the Spirit drove Jesus out into the Wilderness;

title: Mark 1:13
text: And he was there in the Wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan, and among the wild beasts, while the angels ministered to him.

title: Mark 1:14
text: After John had been committed to prison, Jesus went to Galilee, proclaiming the Good News of God--

title: Mark 1:15
text: "The time has come, and the Kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe the Good News."

title: Mark 1:16
text: As Jesus was going along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net in the Sea, for they were fishermen.

title: Mark 1:17
text: "Come and follow me," Jesus said, "and I will set you to fish for men."

title: Mark 1:18
text: They left their nets at once, and followed him.

title: Mark 1:19
text: Going on a little further, he saw James, Zebediah's son, and his brother John, who also were in their boat mending the nets.

title: Mark 1:20
text: Jesus at once called them, and they left their father Zebediah in the boat with the crew, and went after him.

title: Mark 1:21
text: And they walked into Capernaum. On the next Sabbath Jesus went into the Synagogue and began to teach.

title: Mark 1:22
text: The people were amazed at his teaching, for he taught them like one who had authority, and not like the Teachers of the Law.

title: Mark 1:23
text: Now there was in their Synagogue at the time a man under the power of a foul spirit, who called out:

title: Mark 1:24
text: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are--the Holy One of God!"

title: Mark 1:25
text: But Jesus rebuked the spirit: "Be silent! Come out from him."

title: Mark 1:26
text: The foul spirit threw the man into a fit, and with a loud cry came out from him.

title: Mark 1:27
text: And they were all so amazed that they kept asking: "What is this? Strange teaching indeed! He gives his commands with authority even to the foul spirits, and they obey him!"

title: Mark 1:28
text: And the fame of Jesus spread at once in all directions, through the whole neighborhood of Galilee.

title: Mark 1:29
text: As soon as they had come out from the Synagogue, they went, with James and John, into the house of Simon and Andrew.

title: Mark 1:30
text: Now Simon's mother-in-law was lying ill with fever, and they at once told Jesus about her.

title: Mark 1:31
text: Jesus went up to her and, grasping her hand, raised her up; the fever left her, and she began to wait upon them.

title: Mark 1:32
text: In the evening, after sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who were ill or possessed by demons;

title: Mark 1:33
text: And the whole city was gathered round the door.

title: Mark 1:34
text: Jesus cured many who were ill with various diseases, and drove out many demons, and would not permit them to speak, because they knew him to be the Christ.

title: Mark 1:35
text: In the morning, long before daylight, Jesus rose and went out, and, going to a lonely spot, there began to pray.

title: Mark 1:36
text: But Simon and his companions hastened after him;

title: Mark 1:37
text: and, when they found him, they exclaimed: "Every one is looking for you!"

title: Mark 1:38
